FOOD FOR THOUGHT 2.0 — TEAM SUBMISSION CHECKLIST

THE CHALLENGE
What should Swiggy build next for India's college students?
Identify an unmet need, validate it on campus, and propose a solution that
creates student value and a sustainable business opportunity for Swiggy.
Keep a natural link to Swiggy's core ecosystem and capabilities.

SCOPE
Food ordering/discovery/delivery; dining and restaurant experiences;
delivery/fulfilment; affordability/rewards/loyalty/engagement; campus occasions,
communities and group experiences; AI-led improvements to these experiences.
Avoid completely unrelated categories with no natural link to Swiggy.

TEAM & ENTRY
[ ] Eligible Indian college; any batch or academic discipline.
[ ] 2–4 members from the same college; each student joins only one team.
[ ] Every member registers for Swiggy Student Rewards:
    https://swiggy.onelink.me/888564224/u631l8dw
[ ] Register your competition team: https://tally.so/r/6DLy4Y
    Student Rewards signup alone is not competition registration.
[ ] No team changes after registration closes; submit in the prescribed format on time.
    No limit on the number of teams per college.

BUSINESS CASE — 70%: UP TO FIVE SLIDES
1. Campus insight: behaviour, unmet need, operational challenge or opportunity.
2. Proposed solution: product, AI solution, tool, automation, marketing,
   partnership, operational improvement or community initiative.
3. User journey: how it works and how relevant students, restaurant partners,
   delivery partners or internal teams interact with and benefit from it.
4. Business impact: relevant adoption, transactions, frequency, retention,
   revenue, costs, efficiency, productivity or experience outcomes.
5. Execution: pilot and scale-up plan, implementation, estimated cost,
   dependencies, risks and measurable success metrics.
Evaluated on insight, solution quality, business impact, feasibility and scalability.

REQUIRED RESEARCH — AT LEAST ONE
[ ] Student survey, student interviews, campus observations, a small experiment,
    or a prototype/concept test.
[ ] Highlight the key insight and how it influenced the solution.

PROTOTYPE — 30%: SHORT VIDEO WALKTHROUGH
[ ] Functional or simulated prototype, preferably a web app, of the SAME idea.
[ ] Show problem–solution fit and the core user journey from start to finish.
[ ] AI IS MANDATORY: show where it is used and the value it adds.
[ ] Use available Swiggy MCP capabilities wherever relevant.
[ ] Show core functionality/experience; production readiness is not required.
[ ] Briefly explain expected user/Swiggy value at scale.
Evaluated on the working experience, core journey and available Swiggy MCP usage.

CONSENT & USAGE
Do not publish, showcase or share submitted prototypes or materials on any
public platform without prior approval from Swiggy. Any publication/showcase
is subject to Swiggy's applicable internal reviews and approvals.

KEY DATES
Registration deadline: 21 November 2026

OTHER DATES — PROPOSED, SUBJECT TO CONFIRMATION
Submission deadline: 15 December 2026
Result of Round 1: 31 December 2026
National finale: 15 January 2027; location to be announced.
Platform-specific upload instructions will be announced.

SELECTION
AI screening checks eligibility/completeness, scores valid cases, summarizes
ideas/rationale, identifies similar submissions and creates a preliminary leaderboard.
Human validation reviews the top 50 plus near-cutoff, duplication-flagged and
high-potential cases. 6–7 teams present in person to Swiggy leadership.
Finale jury: insight quality, originality, business potential, execution feasibility,
presentation and responses to questions.

REWARDS
National winner: Rs 1,50,000 cash prizes + pre-placement interview opportunity.
First runner-up: Rs 50,000 cash prize.
Top 50: Rs 2,000 DineCash per team (Rs 1,00,000 total).
All registering students: Rs 200 DineCash per student.

Questions: swiggyforstudents@swiggy.in
